india_trends.summary: In this weekly Plain Facts compilation, we present to you data-based insights, with easy-to-read charts, to help you delve deeper into the stories reported by Mint in the week gone by.

india_trends.title: PM Modi urges BRICS to turn its growing economic weight into stronger trade, investment and business partnerships
india_trends.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged BRICS to reduce trade barriers, deepen investment and business ties, and ensure secure sea lanes, while pitching India’s infrastructure, startups, strategic technologies and digital public infrastructure as engines for global growth.

india_trends.title: India’s 7.8% Q1 GDP growth ‘above our expectations’, says IMF amid energy price shock
india_trends.summary: India's economy demonstrated resilience with a real GDP growth of 7.8% in Q1 FY27, surpassing expectations, according to the IMF. Improved data transparency and revisions in GDP estimation were also welcomed, reinforcing India's role as a crucial global growth engine despite energy price shocks.

india_trends.title: In New Delhi, Putin pitches BRICS investment platform, says bloc’s growth outpaces G7 - ‘World is always changing’
india_trends.summary: Putin said the proposed digital investment platform built on the framework of the New Development Bank (NDB) would seek to mobilise private-sector funding and make BRICS economies more competitive.&nbsp;

india_trends.title: Air India's consolidated loss widens to Rs 22,238 crore in FY26
